documents.text: The Green Pastures (film) The Green Pastures is a 1936 American film depicting stories from the Bible as visualized by African-American characters. It starred Rex Ingram (in several roles, including "De Lawd"), Oscar Polk, and Eddie "Rochester" Anderson. It was based on the 1928 novel "Ol' Man Adam an' His Chillun" by Roark Bradford and the 1930 Pulitzer Prize-winning play of the same name by Marc Connelly.
